digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler backend neutrality gate and J7 adapter boundary
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the reconciler package root to allow Data Center and Cloud adapters to share it while preserving the J7 sibling-adapter seal
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would break the J7 seal by enabling jira_datacenter to import from jira
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers like inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py cannot consume that layer

the module's lazy-loaded ADF dependency on adapters/jira/adf.py would need to be routed through a by-path string load if relocated to jira_family, which evades rather than satisfies the AST contract gate
the sweep exemption in test_backend_neutrality.py must document the permanent architectural cost of the shared mapper and J7 seal rather than treating the exemption as temporary relocation debt
